facts.fact: Fungu 68, Ministry of Communication and Information Technology, was proposed TZS 222,589,451,000 for 2026/27: recurrent TZS 13,146,172,000 and development TZS 209,443,279,000 (TZS 98,480,905,000 domestic, TZS 110,962,374,000 external).

The 2026/27 proposal of TZS 222,589,451,000 is lower than the 2025/26 approved TZS 291,533,139,000 (about 23.6% less); domestic development money is unchanged at TZS 98,480,905,000 and external falls from TZS 178,566,578,000 to TZS 110,962,374,000.
